request: Source ticket: MAG-69 — 6. Re-key analytics.vehicle_metrics and vehicle_metric_watermarks on tesla_id. Step 6 of MAG-63. One migration on both tables: collapse duplicate (tesla_id, metric_date) rows, replace vehicle_metrics_account_tesla_date_unique with UNIQUE (tesla_id, metric_date), replace idx_vehicle_metrics_latest with (tesla_id, metric_date DESC), replace vehicle_metric_watermarks_account_tesla_source_unique with UNIQUE (tesla_id, source), DROP COLUMN account_id from both. Drop account_id from the queries and accountID from the Reader/Recalculator ports. LatestMetricsByAccount becomes LatestMetricsForVehicles. Unit tests: excluded. MAG-71 was cancelled and its work folds in here.

tasks.title: Migration — collapse duplicates, swap both unique constraints, recreate idx_vehicle_metrics_latest, DROP COLUMN account_id from both tables
Queries + sqlc — drop account_id from 7 queries, rename LatestVehicleMetricsByAccount to LatestVehicleMetricsByVehicles, regenerate
Ports — 5 signatures drop accountID; LatestMetricsByAccount becomes LatestMetricsForVehicles(ctx, []vehicleref.Ref)
Implementation — consumed.go, recalculate.go, reader.go and the vehicleMetricsStore seam follow the new ports
DB-backed integration test fixups in db_integration_test.go
Docs — internal/analytics/AGENTS.md and the kkpa/context vehicle-metrics guide
LEADER-OWNED cross-module integration — processor.go dedupes by tesla_id; gateway stopgap keeps go build green
Final verification — build, vet, gofmt, migration/boundary/vehicleref guards, index claims with enable_seqscan off

decisions.decision: database design gate confirmed: migration shape, the three-index plan, and DROP COLUMN account_id on both tables
decisions.why: Owner reviewed the schema before/after, the index plan and the irreversible DROP COLUMN, and approved. Dev DB has one account, so no distinguishable data is lost.

decisions.decision: tier 1 leaves go vet ./internal/gateway/... red until tier 2 lands
decisions.why: The gateway stopgap fixes production files only; its test fakes still use the old signatures. go build ./... stays green. Mirrors RM57 T8.
